trigger: After V1 initial counts, 60 pairs were observed with T0 lower-gap exactly 0 and four pairs exactly at 45000s; half-open T0 end-of-day was approximated by its unattainable upper endpoint. Freeze 1-second inclusivity semantics to avoid false possible at equality; retain v1 receipts as historical.
resolution: Timestamp source is second-resolution DBF text. Interpret date-only civil day as closed integer seconds [00:00:00,23:59:59] (equivalent to [00:00,next-midnight) on that lattice). T1 remains [00:00:00,01:00:00] inclusive. Complete timestamp is one exact second.
physical_clock: naive local Mountain civil time; no UTC or DST conversion
triple_criterion: Reuse already frozen v1 exact integer-second triple algorithm, with T0 day end 23:59:59 inclusive; no spatial worlds or GPS outcome predictions.
comparison: Report v1-v2 count deltas, not overwriting frozen originals; recompute pair status-crossing and T0/T1 triple composition using same source ordering
constraints: no individual IDs or timestamps in output
